Gate IPO Access Phase 3: Anthropic (ANT) allocation has been confirmed. A total of 92,100 ANT shares have been allocated for this round. Under the intended subscription rules, allocation quotas will be distributed based on each individual's proportion of the total investment, with an allocation rate of approximately 5.03%. Distribution is expected to be completed within 1-3 hours after this announcement is published. Please refer to the official announcement for details. Details of the allocated shares are as follows:
Total Allocated Shares: 92,100 ANT shares
Price per ANT Share: 83 USDT
Total Value of Allocated Shares: 7,644,300 USDT
Allocation Rate: approximately 5.03% (total value of allocated shares of 7,644,300 USDT / total subscription amount of 152 million USDT)

According to information officially released by Anthropic, the final IPO issue price has been set at $83 per share, which is higher than the reference subscription price range of $70–$78 per share previously displayed on the Gate IPO Access page. The intended subscription price range for Gate IPO Access is for reference only, and the final issue price is subject to the project's official announcement. Upon calculation, the final issue price deviates from the upper limit of the reference range by approximately 6.41%, which does not exceed the 20% price deviation threshold and meets the settlement requirements for this subscription. This subscription will be settled normally and will not affect users' normal allocations or asset processing.
About ANT

Anthropic is an artificial intelligence research company dedicated to providing enterprises and developers with AI models that balance alignment and safety. Anthropic's models are designed with safety and interpretability as priorities, supporting AI applications aligned with human values. The company is committed to advancing responsible AI development through its research and tools, helping enterprises deploy AI in ways that meet ethical standards.
About Gate IPO Access

IPO Access is an IPO participation channel launched by Gate. Users can submit intended subscription applications before a company officially goes public, participate in the initial public offerings of popular global companies, and receive corresponding spot share allocations based on the final allocation results, providing a one-stop investment experience from IPO subscription to stock trading.

Risk Reminder

IPO Access involves high risk. This intended subscription uses a public and fair launch model, but price fluctuations, insufficient market liquidity, and other circumstances may still occur. Please participate cautiously only after understanding the project's background and risks.
